name: White Tower
intro: The White Tower pathway pursues knowledge, deduction and rational understanding, turning accumulated information into versatile supernatural power.

meter.name: Deduction
meter.gain: Repeated observation and analysis of an active ability
meter.full: Reproduce one analyzed ability at full strength; no record book

ability.name: Combat Analysis
ability.label: Passive
ability.description: Combat Analysis — Deals 15% INT Physical damage (25% base DEF bypass); +15% INT; +10 percentage points accuracy; +15% DEF bypass for INT-scaled and caster-formula damage; Damage and hostile effects use accuracy and Dodge; critical, authority and defense modifiers still apply. Passive.

ability.name: Analysis Weakness
ability.label: Active
ability.description: Analysis Weakness — Deals 130% INT Physical damage (25% base DEF bypass); +30% DEF bypass on this cast; Damage and hostile effects use accuracy and Dodge; critical, authority and defense modifiers still apply. 15 SP · Cooldown 1 turn.

ability.name: Predictive Guard
ability.label: Passive
ability.description: Predictive Guard — Reduces incoming magic damage by 20% after shields. Passive.

ability.name: Spell Imitation
ability.label: Active
ability.description: Spell Imitation — From Sequence 6, analyze an enemy ability cast twice. At 100 charge, imitate it at full strength with its original SP cost and cooldown; no record book.; If the resolved cast deals no damage, follows its utility effects with a 35% basic strike against the current enemy. Pays the stored ability’s SP cost and cooldown.

ability.name: Prophetic Evade
ability.label: Active
ability.description: Prophetic Evade — 100% chance: +40 percentage points Dodge for 1 turn; If the resolved cast deals no damage, follows its utility effects with a 35% basic strike against the current enemy. 45 SP · Cooldown 3 turns.

ability.name: Prophetic Intervention
ability.label: Active
ability.description: Prophetic Intervention — Negates incoming direct hits and reflects 150% INT Magic damage to the attacker until your next turn; periodic damage does not trigger reflection; If the resolved cast deals no damage, follows its utility effects with a 35% basic strike against the current enemy. 50 SP · Cooldown 3 turns.

ability.name: Omniscient Eye
ability.label: Passive
ability.description: Omniscient Eye — +25% INT; +25% DEF bypass for INT-scaled and caster-formula damage; Immune to Illusion. Passive.

ability.name: Magic Barrier
ability.label: Active
ability.description: Magic Barrier — Grants a 30% Max HP magic shield; lasts until depleted or dispelled; If the resolved cast deals no damage, follows its utility effects with a 35% basic strike against the current enemy. 80 SP · Cooldown 4 turns.

ability.name: Omniscient Rewrite
ability.label: Active
ability.description: Omniscient Rewrite — Immediately restores 280% INT HP, capped at Max HP; If the resolved cast deals no damage, follows its utility effects with a 35% basic strike against the current enemy. 95 SP · Cooldown 4 turns.

ability.name: Divine Enlightenment
ability.label: Active Authority
ability.description: Divine Enlightenment — Deals 390% INT True damage (ignores DEF and elemental resistance); Damage and hostile effects use accuracy and Dodge; critical, authority and defense modifiers still apply. 120 SP · Cooldown 5 turns.
